description: Campaign loop orchestration contract — main cycle, scene dispatch, state transitions

output_schema.npc_state_changes: dict of npc_id -> updated NPC fields

active_loop_schema.description: Position pointer written to campaign_state.active_loop. Records exactly which loop owns control and which step it is on, so the agent RESUMES the precise step instead of improvising from memory.
active_loop_schema.loop: string — one of: combat|social|challenge|rest|travel|merchant|item-use|exploration|null (null only between sessions)
active_loop_schema.step: integer >= 1 — current step number within that loop's SKILL.md Flow
active_loop_schema.round: integer >= 0 — combat round (0 when not in combat)
active_loop_schema.turn_actor: string|null — character_id whose turn it is (combat/initiative), else null
active_loop_schema.resume_hint: string — human-readable exact next step to execute

state_ownership.description: CRITICAL: characters/<id>.json is a SHARED POOL referenced by multiple campaigns. Per-play volatile state MUST live in this campaign's campaign_state.json, NEVER be written back to the shared sheet — writing volatile state to the sheet corrupts every other campaign using that character.

static_on_sheet.fields: ability_scores, class/subclass, features, proficiencies, inventory, max_hp, total hit dice, AC formula, attack bonuses/damage. Changed ONLY by character creation and level-up (durable progression).

volatile_in_campaign_state.fields: current_hp (map: character_id -> int), hit_dice_used (map: character_id -> int), spell_slots_used (map), ammo (map), conditions (map: character_id -> [condition]), party_xp, loot_collected.

state_ownership.rule: Loops COMPUTE from the sheet (max_hp, mods, dice) + campaign_state (current values), and WRITE current_hp/hit_dice_used/conditions/slots/ammo ONLY to campaign_state. rest recovers by lowering hit_dice_used and raising current_hp toward max_hp — it does NOT edit the sheet. Only level-up and creation write the sheet.

one_loop_flag_active.rule: At most one of {combat,social,challenge,rest,travel,exploration}.active may be true at a time. Entering a loop sets its flag true AND clears all others.
one_loop_flag_active.why: Prevents stale flags from routing the wrong loop. Priority ordering must never be the thing that saves a malformed state.

active_loop_matches_flag.rule: active_loop.loop MUST equal the single loop whose .active flag is true (or 'exploration' when none of the encounter flags are set).
active_loop_matches_flag.why: The pointer and the flags are two views of one fact; they may not disagree.

every_active_flag_has_a_rule.rule: Any *.active flag that can be true must have a matching rule in contracts/state-evaluation-contract.json (includes exploration).
every_active_flag_has_a_rule.why: A flag with no dispatch rule silently falls through to narration — a ghost state.

no_dispatch_to_missing_handler.rule: A loop may only be dispatched if its skill directory exists under .claude/skills/<loop>/. Never route to a stub or a nonexistent handler.
no_dispatch_to_missing_handler.why: Routing social/travel/merchant/item-use to a stub is why steps were skipped pre-build.

compute_canonical_display_derived.rule: Resolve all mechanics (rolls, saves, damage, AC, recovery) from characters/<id>.json + campaign_state.json (canonical). Display tactics from party_toolkit.json + battle-plans/ (derived). Read BOTH each loop iteration.
compute_canonical_display_derived.why: Numbers single-sourced in the sheet; strategy single-sourced in the toolkit. Neither may hold a different number for the same fact.
